title: ConvertIT
description: Cycle between Zombie Villager and Villager with ease!
body:
This mod allows you to convert your Villagers into Zombie Villagers regardless of the difficulty and reduce the time taken for the Zombie Villager to cure back to a Villager!

This Mod was created as a result of people playing on servers wanting to cure the Villagers to reduce their prices but it was either they had to deal with hard difficulty or let their villagers sacrifice themselves.


The Mod also includes a config file `convertit.json` where you can change the settings:
```
{
  "guaranteedConversion": true, (Always convert a Villager to a Zombie Villager)
  "cureTime": 1200 (The time to cure the Zombie Villager back to a Villager in ticks [20 ticks = 1 second])
}
```
Mod Icon taken from Minecraft (Golden Apple)
